Convaincus que la souveraineté numérique est un enjeu stratégique majeur, nous concevons des architectures sécurisées, performantes et indépendantes, portées par des partenariats solides avec des acteurs clés comme SENS et Scaleway. Acteur de référence sur l'intelligence artificielle, nous faisons évoluer les standards d'ingénierie modernes. À travers notre plateforme GenAI RAISE et notre statut de partenaire Anthropic Select (au sein du Claude Partner Network), nous plaçons le Context Engineering et l'IA générative au cœur de nos pratiques.

  • 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l’IA.

  • 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et en Belgique.

  • Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du Claude Partner Network.

Nous intégrons l'IA à nos propres pratiques d'ingénierie (utilisation quotidienne de RAISE et Claude Code) pour automatiser les tâches répétitives et concentrer nos efforts sur la conception d'architectures résilientes.


▪️ À propos de la mission

En tant qu'Expert & Trainer GenAI, tu t'inscris à la croisée de l'ingénierie logicielle, de la formation d'élite et du conseil stratégique. Tu es le garant de la mise en œuvre pragmatique et sécurisée de l'IA chez nos clients.


Architecture & Ingénierie GenAI

Tu concois, pilotes et déploies des architectures GenAI robustes et prêtes pour la production :




  • Model Engineering & Contexte : Arbitrage et choix des LLMs (Claude, Gemini, GPT, Open Source), optimisation des paramètres (fenêtre de contexte, context caching, system prompts) et maîtrise du Model Context Protocol (MCP).




  • Pipelines Avancés & RAG : Conception de stratégies de retrieval complexes (chunking, bases vectorielles, GraphRAG, hybride) et orchestration de workflows agentiques (LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, patterns ReAct).




  • Industrialisation & FinOps : Évaluation de la fiabilité (LLM-as-a-judge), maîtrise des coûts au token, guardrails de sécurité (AI Act, prompt injection, étanchéité des données) et déploiement multi-cloud (Vertex AI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI).




Formation & Transmission "Développeur Augmenté" (SFEIR Institute)

Tu es le visage de l'excellence pédagogique de SFEIR. Tu conçois et animes nos parcours phares (jusqu'à 60% de pratique / labs) pour transformer les méthodes de dev chez nos clients :




  • Agentic Coding : Acculturation aux workflows de développement assisté (Specify → Plan → Tasks → Implement → Validate) via des outils comme Claude Code, GitHub Copilot ou Gemini CLI.




  • Standardisation d'équipe : Diffusion des bonnes pratiques de gestion de contexte (CLAUDE.md, règles modulaires, génération de tests) et création de serveurs MCP sécurisés.

Conseil & Stratégie GenAI

  • Architecture de Solutions : Arbitrages Build vs Buy, conception de couches intermédiaires (Context Graphs) pour maîtriser la dette technique et l'économie du token.




  • Gouvernance & Change : Accompagnement des instances dirigeantes (COMEX, CODIR) sur la gestion du risque, la conformité et la conduite du changement.

Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

  • Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

  • Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

  • Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

  • Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

  • The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.

We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.

We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.

  • Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.

  • Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.

  • Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

About

Fabriq, what we do and why

Our Ambition

Make European industry shine by making factories more competitive and operators more autonomous. With Lighthouse, we bring AI to every level of the factory, from the operator to group leadership.

What We Do

Fabriq is the Operating System for production shop floors. Our SaaS platform digitizes lean management rituals (routines, SQCDP, QRQC) and centralizes shop-floor data from more than 700 industrial sites. Lighthouse, our AI team, builds AI features into this product for our 3 personas: the operator, the manager and leadership.

Proof Points

€26M raised in total, including a €22M round in June 2025 led by Expedition Capital.

Profitable since 2024, aiming for €50M ARR by 2029.

700+ sites equipped across 43 countries, at Safran, Airbus, Danone, LVMH and Scania.

AI Search shipped, a Problem Solving Coach in POC with beta-tester customers and a first co-build signed with an industrial company.

140 people and a strong craft culture: systematic pair programming, TDD and AI used daily by every engineer.

Job Description

Context

Lighthouse is becoming a full product team. You join Bertrand's team (VP Engineering), working directly with our CEO and hand in hand with a dedicated Product Manager. You manage 2 Senior AI Software Engineer, with a third hire on the way, target of 3 to 4 engineers. The team is shielded from run work and focuses on the AI product.

The Goal

Ship the 3 AI features on the roadmap to production within 12 months, one per persona, on data foundations ready for our 700 sites.

Key Challenges

Player-coach leadership: You split your time between leading and building. You build pipelines and features yourself and pair with the team, while coaching, setting standards and hiring.

Knock down the first dominoes: You take the Problem Solving Coach from POC to production, then launch data synthesis for managers and AI analytics for leadership. The agentic stack is built from scratch in TypeScript on Deno, with frontier models through AWS Bedrock.

Data foundations: You design and build resilient, well-governed ETL/ELT pipelines on shop-floor data, so that each building block makes the next feature easier to build.

Co-build and roadmap: You deliver our first co-build, which tailors our features and lays the groundwork for a multi-site steering tool for leadership. With your PM, you fully shape the roadmap: the foundations are solid and much is still to be decided.

Must-haves

Preferred Experience

Experience: 5 to 8 years in data engineering or data analytics, including at least 1 to 2 years managing a team (feedback, growth, hiring).

Pipelines in production: You have designed and run data pipelines (ETL/ELT) in production, with real stakes around quality, resilience and governance.

Data for AI: You have contributed to AI features in production, on data preparation, evaluation or integration into an existing product.

Hands-on every day: You still build regularly (SQL, Python, pipelines), use AI every day in your work, and are comfortable with pair programming and TDD.

Nice to have

These skills remain optional.

Experience fine-tuning or deploying open-weight models in production.

Some software development experience, ideally in TypeScript, the language of our stack.

Compensation And Setup

Package: €90K to €100K gross per year.

Perks: 7 weeks of paid leave per year, Alan health insurance, Swile meal card, a company event every quarter and an annual offsite.

Location: Our offices are in Paris 10th and we favor a Paris-based profile, with a hybrid setup.

Start date: From January 2027.

Languages: Fluent French and English.

Screening call with TA (30 min).

Management interview with Bertrand, VP Engineering (45 min): your management experience and your player-coach approach.

Technical interview with Alan, Head of Tech (1h45): Bring Your Own Code on one of your projects, your technical choices and how you use AI, followed by a data pipeline exercise.

Meet the Team: an informal coffee chat with the Lighthouse team.

Founder check with Octave, co-founder (30 min): vision, mission and Lighthouse strategy.

Additional Information

Contract Type: Full-Time

Location: Paris

Education Level: Master's Degree

Experience: > 5 years

Possible partial remote

Salary: between 90000€ and 100000€ / year

LLM-backed features fail probabilistically. Agents take actions no runbook anticipated. "Is my app healthy?" is becoming an unanswerable question for a whole generation of AI-native software. You will build reliability for this kind of software.

Build and ship with AI

Talk to our users

You will talk directly to the developers, DevOps and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) teams who are on-call, debugging incidents, or wiring Checkly into production pipelines. Customer calls and the weekly support rotation are part of the job, not a distraction from it.

Find the right problems to solve

In a world where the cost of building software trends to zero, the hard part is picking what to build. You will focus on real developer pain: flaky tests and flaky checks, unclear failures, noisy alerts. You will favour pragmatic solutions that ship quickly, validate assumptions in production, and compound into long-term reliability improvements.

Own your work end to end

From shaping the initial idea, through implementation and rollout, to watching how it behaves in production. You will take part in on-call and help support customers when things don’t work as expected.

Fabriq est la solution innovante de pilotage d'atelier qui améliore la productivité des équipes de production. Fabriq rassemble et digitalise tous les outils de votre système d'excellence opérationnelle (AIC, plans d'actions, tour de terrain et audits, résolution de problèmes, management visuel et KPI).

Grâce à Fabriq, les équipes de production peuvent gagner en efficacité, résoudre les problèmes deux fois plus vite et améliorer l'efficience de 2 à 5% en capitalisant sur les données terrain.

Job Description

  • The company, its business and its ambition

The ambition. Fabriq is bringing European industry into the 21st century: making factories more competitive and frontline teams more autonomous. This is not only a software play, it is the industrial relocalisation project.

The business. Fabriq is the SaaS platform that replaces the whiteboards and Excel spreadsheets still running 80% of industrial sites. Operators, team leads and plant managers track real-time KPIs (safety, quality, lead time, productivity), surface and solve shop-floor problems, run their daily routines and collaborate across teams in one place. The long-term ambition is to become the Operating System of every production floor.

The proof.

  • 700+ industrial sites equipped across 43+ countries.
  • Reference customers such as Safran, Airbus, Renault, Scania, LVMH, Andros, Bel, Merck and Lonza.
  • Profitable since late 2024, then €22M raised in June 2025 with Expedition Capital to accelerate in the US, the UK and DACH.
  • A team of ~130 people, and an AI roadmap that is already in customers' hands rather than on a slide.
  • The role

Context : You join the AI team, a two-person unit led by Jean (Product Lead) alongside Halim, Senior Engineer who has built much of the Fabriq product. This team operates as a prototyping squad at the front edge of the company: it tests new ideas, measures market appetite and decides whether Fabriq goes there. Products are in alpha, cycles are short, the roadmap is directional. The team also works weekly with Octave, co-founder, which gives you direct exposure to the strategic decisions.

Objective : Become Halim's pair and second engineer on AI, reach full autonomy on the stack and the customer context within 6 months, and take Fabriq's AI products from alpha to something industrial teams rely on every day.

Challenges

  • Taking AI prototypes to production quality. Conversational and voice-driven agents, plugged into real industrial data and used by real teams on the floor. You take them from alpha to something people rely on daily: answer quality, reliability, and the cost per interaction that decides whether a use case scales or gets dropped.
  • Prototyping to convince. Part of the roadmap is co-built with partner customers, which means it is sold before it is built. Specs move as customers shape them, timelines are tight, and you build fast to prove a use case is worth pursuing. Testing a lot and abandoning a lot is part of the deal.
  • Agentic engineering from scratch. No Mastra, no LangGraph, no off-the-shelf framework. Everything is hand-built in TypeScript and Deno on top of frontier models called through AWS Bedrock. When the team needs something like agent memory compaction, you design it yourself. This is genuinely custom, sparsely documented territory, and that is precisely the technical interest of the role.
  • Setting the technical direction with Halim. You are the second engineer, not an extra pair of hands: code reviews, architecture debates, and the freedom to arrive with your own proposals rather than waiting for a ticket.

Pionnier de la Bank-As-A-Service, Okali, accompagne les entreprises et les fintechs dans la conception, le développement et le pilotage de solutions de paiement innovantes. Nous avons notamment contribué à la naissance et au développement d’entreprises à succès telles que Lydia, Spendesk, Blank ou encore Limonetik.

Le poste en quelques mots

Okali est un acteur bancaire dont le métier est avant tout opérationnel : exécuter des paiements, entrer en relation avec les clients, gérer le cycle de vie des comptes et assurer la conformité de chaque opération. Une erreur sur ces parcours touche directement l'argent et les données de nos clients. Vous êtes le garant de la qualité de bout en bout : vous vérifiez que les parcours métier (virements SEPA entrants et sortants, prélèvements, opérations par carte, ouverture de compte, rappels de virement, saisies) se comportent de la même manière sur tous les environnements, du développement à la préproduction.

En tant que Senior QA Engineer, vous concevez et maintenez la suite de tests qui couvre ces parcours, en étroite collaboration avec les développeurs, les équipes produit et les opérations. Vous ne vous contentez pas d'exécuter des scénarios : vous décidez de ce qui doit être testé, à quel niveau et à quelle fréquence, et vous êtes le premier interlocuteur lorsqu'un scénario échoue en préproduction. Vous êtes aussi un point d'appui pour l'équipe : vous défendez une vision exigeante de la qualité, sans en faire un frein à la livraison.

Vos missions

  • Concevoir et maintenir la suite de tests de bout en bout rédigée en Gherkin, avec des scénarios lisibles par les équipes métier.
  • Définir la priorisation des scénarios (smoke, criticité p0, p1, p2) et veiller à leur exécution quotidienne en préproduction.
  • Analyser les échecs pour distinguer un défaut produit d'une instabilité de test, et supprimer les tests non fiables.
  • Concevoir des jeux de données de test déterministes (comptes, IBAN, cartes, transactions) et les rendre réutilisables.
  • Tester les API signées, les messages ISO 20022 et les traitements asynchrones, en vérifiant les effets réels sur les comptes et les soldes.
  • Étendre la couverture aux actions du Back Office, dans un navigateur, pour sécuriser les parcours utilisés par les équipes opérations et conformité.
  • Contribuer aux tests de charge pour garantir les performances des traitements de paiement.
  • Participer aux revues de spécifications dès la conception, et aux analyses d'incidents.
  • Rédiger des tickets Jira explicites et découpés en sous-tâches qui permettent à un développeur de reproduire un défaut sans poser de question.

Notre stack technique

Notre suite de tests de bout en bout est écrite en TypeScript, avec Cucumber pour les scénarios Gherkin, et s'appuie sur le client de requêtes HTTP de Playwright. Elle signe les requêtes en RSA SHA-256 conformément aux exigences de nos API et s'exécute sur les environnements dev, integration et preprod. Les rapports HTML et JSON sont générés à chaque exécution, les journaux d'audit sont archivés, et les campagnes sont planifiées chaque matin (smoke) et chaque soir (p0) via GitHub Actions. Les tests unitaires et d'intégration reposent sur Jest, avec PostgreSQL et LocalStack pour simuler les services AWS. Les tests de charge sont écrits avec k6. L'ensemble du code tourne sur Node.js et Bun.

Vous n'êtes pas attendu sur l'ensemble de cette stack dès le premier jour. Nous recherchons avant tout une personne capable d'apprendre vite, de remettre en question nos pratiques quand c'est pertinent et d'en proposer de meilleures.

Votre profil

Nous valorisons au même niveau vos compétences techniques et vos qualités humaines. Un profil senior, pour nous, sait faire et sait faire ensemble.

Sur le plan technique, vous maîtrisez l'automatisation de tests en TypeScript et savez écrire des scénarios Gherkin qui restent lisibles pour un responsable opérationnel. Vous avez une pratique des tests d'API, idéalement REST et GraphQL, et vous savez interroger une base PostgreSQL pour vérifier l'état réel d'un compte ou d'une transaction. Vous comprenez les mécanismes de signature de requêtes et les formats de messages financiers (ISO 20022, SEPA, EBICS), ou vous vous y formez rapidement. Vous savez tester des flux asynchrones, écrire des tests de charge et intégrer vos tests dans une chaîne d'intégration continue. Une expérience de Jira est attendue : vous rédigez des tickets explicites, avec un objectif, un périmètre, des critères d'acceptation et des sous-tâches (reproduction, correctif, vérification), et vous savez distinguer un défaut d'une instabilité de test. Dans un métier aussi régulé que la banque, la trace de chaque anomalie et de sa résolution fait partie du travail, au même titre que le test lui-même.

Vous utilisez l'IA générative au quotidien, avec discernement : pour générer des jeux de données, explorer des cas limites ou rédiger des scénarios, en relisant systématiquement ce qu'elle produit et en ne lui confiant jamais de données clients. Savoir expliquer comment et pourquoi vous l'employez compte autant, pour nous, que le résultat obtenu.

Sur le plan humain, vous avez un esprit critique et une rigueur qui inspirent confiance sans créer de tension. Vous savez expliquer un défaut à un développeur de façon factuelle, et un risque métier à un responsable opérationnel en termes simples. Vous êtes méthodique dans la préparation de vos campagnes de tests, autonome sur la priorisation, et vous assumez vos choix de couverture, y compris lorsqu'ils sont contestés. Vous aimez transmettre : la qualité se construit collectivement, et vous aidez les développeurs à écrire des tests qui leur servent réellement.

Environnement de travail

Architecting durable, long-running workflows and background processes on our workflow orchestration system (Restate). You’ll also build the pipelines that move data between our warehouse, our databases and our products, reliably and at scale.

Modeling large datasets so they can be queried and visualized fast. Roadmap Creation and Ideation

Contributing actively to the roadmap: identifying the right tradeoffs and bringing ideas from both a product and an engineering perspective.

AI as a multiplier

About Kernel

Agents are starting to sell, buy and operate on behalf of companies. But before an agent can close a deal, qualify an account, route a lead or assess risk, it has to answer a basic question: which company is this?

Today, that answer is messy, and no one answers it reliably. Business identity lives across CRMs, ERPs and third-party datasets full of duplicates, missing parent companies, stale addresses and incorrect enrichment. The cost shows up across the enterprise: sales teams miss revenue opportunities because they lack the right account context; operations teams take on avoidable exposure because risk signals are fragmented or wrong; and finance teams end up chasing, writing off, or defaulting on bad debt that should have been caught earlier.

Humans have worked around that mess for years. Agents cannot. They need a reliable business identity layer they can trust.

Kernel is building that layer: the business registry for agents. We issue a permanent KERN ID for every business, plus the context an agent needs to act on it.
